entries.279eee2129a1854c: In addition to 3PL (comprehensive outsourcing of logistics operations), which covers storage and distribution processing at domestic warehouses and the operation of distribution centers and warehouses, this business also handles cold chain logistics for delivering chilled and frozen products and in-building logistics for large mixed-use facilities. The companies responsible are Sagawa Global Logistics Co., Ltd., World Supply Co., Ltd., Meito Transportation Co., Ltd., Hutech Norin Co., Ltd. and 14 other companies (18 companies in total, of which 1 is an affiliate). In July 2024, the company brought Meito Transportation Co., Ltd. (formerly C&F Logi Holdings Co., Ltd.) into the group. In November 2025, Sagawa Global Logistics Co., Ltd. sold its equity interest in Shanghai Hongdi Logistics Technology Co., Ltd., and it has been excluded from the scope of consolidation. Operating revenue from external customers was ¥202,798 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (restated figure of ¥143,089 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025).

entries.2c0262c0caa2c169: The group has built a logistics delivery network that can meet the diverse needs of corporate customers in shape, frequency and volume, and has focused on contracting logistics operations under 'from B', combining BtoB (between businesses) and BtoC (from businesses to individuals). Building on this network, it provides 'Total Logistics', which combines not only the transport and delivery of parcels but also handling of products requiring temperature control, warehousing and distribution processing, and international transport, to optimize customers' entire supply chains. In terms of commercial flow, the structure is one in which the logistics solutions provided by the Delivery, Logistics and Global Logistics Businesses are supported as business infrastructure by the Real Estate Business and the logistics-related services classified under 'Other'. Handled volume in the Delivery Business was 1,360 million pieces for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (the prior-year figure, restated after a change in the aggregation scope, was 1,308 million pieces), of which Hikyaku Takkyūbin accounted for 1,324 million pieces (prior year: 1,271 million pieces). As of March 31, 2026, sales drivers, who handle pickups and sales activities, numbered approximately 20,000. In the Logistics Business, in July 2024 the group brought Meito Transportation Co., Ltd. (formerly 'C&F Logi Holdings Co., Ltd.') into the group, gaining a foundation in cold-chain logistics. In the Global Logistics Business, EXPOLANKA HOLDINGS Limited has strengths in apparel transport from Asia to North America, and Morrison Express Worldwide Corporation, brought into the group in May 2025, has strengths in transporting semiconductor equipment and high-tech products. The Real Estate Business develops integrated logistics facilities for the Delivery and Logistics Businesses (SRC, etc.), and obtains funds for developing new facilities by converting logistics facilities held by the group into trust beneficiary interests and selling them; asset management and operation after the sale are handled by SG Asset Max Co., Ltd.
entries.2c2ec54283104bdb: This business provides goods transport services, centered on parcel delivery, to corporate and individual customers through a nationwide network, and it is the category with the largest operating revenue from external customers.
entries.3376e4caeb4436af: Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,644,762 million, up 11.2% from the previous year. This was mainly due to the consolidation effect of Meito/Huetech, brought into the group from the third quarter of the fiscal year ended March 2025, and Morrison, brought into the group from the second quarter of the fiscal year ended March 2026. In existing businesses, the 4% increase in handled volume in the Delivery Business over the prior year contributed to higher revenue. On the other hand, at EXPOLANKA in the Global Logistics Business, air volumes fell below the same period of the prior year, and air and ocean freight rates trended downward due to the effects of U.S. trade policy and other factors, resulting in lower revenue. Operating revenue from external customers was: Delivery Business ¥1,048,510 million (up 4.5% year on year); Global Logistics Business ¥321,596 million (up 25.4% year on year); Logistics Business ¥202,798 million (up 41.7% year on year); Real Estate Business ¥15,434 million (down 35.6% year on year); and Other ¥56,421 million (up 6.9% year on year). Revenue from contracts with customers was ¥1,614,988 million, and other revenue was ¥29,774 million. Prior-year figures have been restated following a change in reportable segment classifications.

entries.833781efe2525b26: This business provides goods transport services, centered on parcel delivery, to corporate and individual customers through a nationwide network, and it is the category with the largest operating revenue from external customers. The companies responsible are Sagawa Express Co., Ltd., Sagawa Humony Co., Ltd., SG Moving Co., Ltd. and 8 other companies (11 companies in total). Operating revenue from external customers was ¥1,048,510 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (restated figure of ¥1,003,005 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025). Operating revenue from external customers for Hikyaku Takkyubin across the group was ¥751,285 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026. As of March 31, 2026, there were approximately 20,000 sales drivers responsible for pickups and sales activities. From the start of the current fiscal year, World Supply Co., Ltd., which operates delivery agency and in-building delivery services, was reclassified to the Logistics Business.
entries.868bd1e49e678a70: This business provides international transport, including air and sea freight forwarding, and logistics services within each region at overseas bases. From the current fiscal year, the forwarding business and overseas 3PL business, which had been included in the Logistics Business, were separated and established as a new reportable segment. EXPOLANKA HOLDINGS Limited has strengths in apparel transport centered on trade lanes from Asia to North America, while Morrison Express Worldwide Corporation, which joined the group in May 2025, has strengths in transporting semiconductor equipment and high-tech products mainly within Asia and from Asia to North America. The companies responsible include SGH Global Japan Co., Ltd., EXPOLANKA HOLDINGS Limited and Morrison Express Worldwide Corporation, among 168 companies in total (of which 6 are affiliates). Operating revenue from external customers was ¥321,596 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (restated figure of ¥256,382 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025).
entries.8b45c61556ac2d1f: It is characterized by combining functions such as transport and delivery, handling of temperature-controlled storage, warehousing and distribution processing, and international transport, built on a logistics delivery network that can respond to the diverse needs of corporate customers in shape, frequency and volume. The company says that pickup and sales activities by sales drivers in the Delivery Business (approximately 20,000 as of March 31, 2026) and customer contact points in the Logistics and Global Logistics Businesses complement and reinforce each other, leading to expanded service areas across the group. In domestic 3PL, it cites as a strength that, in coordination with the Delivery Business, it can take on in a single contract everything from distribution processing and logistics center operations to transport to delivery destinations.

Group companies provide, both inside and outside the group, services such as an insurance agency business for transport-related non-life insurance, truck fuel sales, maintenance and sales of transport vehicles, development and operation of logistics systems, cash-on-delivery services for parcel delivery, and personnel dispatch and contracting of operations, mainly for work contracted within logistics facilities. The companies responsible are Sagawa Advance Co., Ltd., SG Motors Co., Ltd., SG System Co., Ltd., SG Fielder Co., Ltd. and 4 other companies (8 companies in total). Operating revenue from external customers was ¥56,421 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (¥52,786 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025).
entries.b4034e83387ca4c9: Customers are mainly corporate customers that entrust logistics operations, and in the Delivery Business it provides goods transport services to both corporate and individual customers. For individual customers, it provides "Real Commerce," which allows luggage delivery and souvenir shipping through prepayment and simple reception at locations where people gather, such as tourist sites, airports, stations and commercial facilities. Cross-border EC, Real Commerce and low-temperature logistics are fields the company regards as growth areas, and in the fiscal year ended March 2026, helped by the expansion of the EC market, the number of parcels handled, especially those related to cross-border EC, increased significantly. There is no specific customer whose operating revenue accounts for 10% or more of operating revenue in the consolidated statement of income. Operating revenue is classified based on customer location, and for the fiscal year ended March 2026 it was ¥1,328,579 million in Japan and ¥316,183 million overseas.

entries.bda1114a296cb9a3: In March 2022 it formulated "SGH Vision 2030" (Grow the new Story. Together nurturing a new society through new logistics.), a long-term vision through the fiscal year ending March 2031, and in March 2025 it set as its desired state "to continue to be an indispensable presence (that is, infrastructure) for customers and society." The management targets for the fiscal year ending March 2031 are operating revenue of ¥2.2 trillion and profit attributable to owners of parent of ¥98 billion. To achieve them, it is pursuing the medium-term management plan "SGH Story 2027" from the fiscal year ended March 2026 to the fiscal year ending March 2028, with the basic policy of "advancing total logistics and expanding the global logistics base" and 3 strategies: ① expanding domestic service areas and the global logistics base, ② enhancing management resources that support growth, and ③ initiatives toward sustainable management. It says that in the first year of the medium-term management plan, cross-border EC, a growth area, grew in the Delivery Business and the parcel-count target was achieved ahead of plan, while part of the Global Logistics Business fell behind plan owing to the effects of U.S. trade policy, geopolitical risks and other factors.
entries.be80794dbb863258: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥59,066 million, up 1.6% from the previous year. In this period, the company recorded as income gains on sales of policy-held shares and compensation related to the vacating of business premises by Warudo Sapurai Co., Ltd., and recorded as losses the loss on transfer of equity interests in Shanghai Hongdi Logistics Technology Co., Ltd. and impairment losses. On the cost side, the Delivery Business has raised outsourcing unit rates paid to partner companies and implemented base pay increases for employees, and costs, centered on personnel and outsourcing expenses, are trending upward. In response, the company says it sets prices, taking into account the volume and costs of each transaction, under a policy of collecting appropriate freight rates.
entries.cdf19e960ff9f953: This business develops, leases and manages real estate, centered on logistics facilities, which are the business infrastructure supporting logistics solutions. It develops SRC and other logistics facilities that integrate the Delivery Business and the Logistics Business, and it obtains funds for developing new facilities by converting logistics facilities held by the group into trust beneficiary rights and selling them. After the sale, SG Asset Max Co., Ltd. handles asset management and operation, and it also conducts solar power generation and electricity sales using logistics facilities. The companies responsible are SG Realty Co., Ltd. and 1 other company (2 companies in total). Operating revenue from external customers was ¥15,434 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (¥23,976 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025).

entries.fe69524d5ab39271: SG HOLDINGS CO.,LTD. is a pure holding company, established in March 2006 through a sole share transfer in which Sagawa Express Co., Ltd. became a wholly owned subsidiary. The group consists of the company, 201 consolidated subsidiaries and 7 equity-method affiliates, and operates businesses including the Delivery, Logistics, Global Logistics and Real Estate Businesses. The number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 60,483. Its corporate philosophy is to respond to the trust of customers and society and grow together, to create new value and contribute to the development of society, and to keep challenging and pursue all possibilities; under the founding spirit of 'Hikyaku no Seishin (Kokoro)', it seeks to improve its services and quality. The company and its consolidated subsidiary SG HOLDINGS GLOBAL PTE. LTD. (overseas business oversight) are corporate (common) functions that do not provide solutions or services and do not belong to any reportable segment.
